description: This file defines event types, event argument classes, delegate types, and a container class for handling various document-related events in the PDFsharp library, such as page creation, removal, movement, and graphics actions.

classes.name: PageEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for page-related events, containing the affected page, page index, and event type.

classes.name: PageGraphicsEventArgs
classes.description: Event arguments for graphics-related events on a page, including the page, graphics object, and action type.

classes.name: DocumentEvents
classes.description: A class encapsulating all document-related events, providing methods to invoke events such as page added, removed, and graphics actions.

methods.name: OnPageAdded
methods.description: Raises the event when a page is added.

methods.name: OnPageRemoved
methods.description: Raises the event when a page is removed.

methods.name: OnPageGraphicsCreated
methods.description: Raises the event when a page's graphics object is created.

methods.name: OnPageGraphicsAction
methods.description: Raises the event when an action occurs on a page's graphics object.
